subject: Human Body
title: UV Protection and Vitamin D
description: A short lesson to help you apply UV Protection and Vitamin D.

hook.text: Your skin makes vitamin D from sunlight. But too much sun causes cancer. The skin walks a razor-thin line daily.

buildup.text: UVB rays convert a cholesterol molecule in skin into vitamin D3. 15 minutes of midday sun can produce your daily need.

discovery.text: Melanin blocks UV penetration. Darker skin needs more sun exposure for the same vitamin D output.

twist.text: Sunscreen blocks both UV damage and vitamin D synthesis.

climax.text: Skin balances UV protection against vitamin D production. Too little sun means deficiency.

punchline.text: Same sunlight makes vitamins and causes cancer. Balance is everything.

quiz.question: Why is vitamin D deficiency now a global problem?
options: The ozone layer blocks all vitamin D-producing UV rays
Modern indoor lifestyles and sunscreen block the UV needed for synthesis
Humans evolved to get vitamin D only from food
